Smart Jowi dashboard compatibility assets

Chart.js 4.4.0 and Material Symbols Outlined were copied from the installed
django-unfold package used by the trusted Smart Jowi dashboard. Their upstream
licenses are included beside the files.

Plus Jakarta Sans was downloaded from the official Google Fonts distribution
referenced by the original dashboard template. It is licensed under the SIL
Open Font License; the license is included as PlusJakartaSans.OFL.txt.

These files are served only from the loopback desktop control server. The
compatibility dashboard performs no runtime font, script, or CDN requests.
